DEMO STUDIO / LIQUIDITY INTELLIGENCE

Cash Sweep Agent

A treasury decision-support concept using expected receipts, payments and liquidity needs to propose explainable intercompany cash movements.

← All demos
In development · Concept & decision lab
SAP S/4HANACash poolingIn-House CashAI decision support

BEFORE

Cash sits idle in one entity while another draws on credit. Sweep rules are fixed, and multi-bank positions are pieced together by hand.

AFTER

Balances, expected receipts and payments, and liquidity buffers drive an explainable sweep proposal. Treasury approves it, and SAP S/4HANA executes it within existing controls.

The business problem

Cash can accumulate in one entity while another needs funding. Fixed sweep rules may not reflect changing obligations and liquidity buffers.

Value to evaluate

Intended to support working-capital decisions, with opportunities to evaluate borrowing costs, liquidity availability and operational effort.

Controls & accountability

Treasury reviews the recommendation and rationale. Payment execution stays within SAP approval workflows and established treasury controls.

Project evidence & maturity

Whitepaper, presentation and recorded webinar. This is a development concept; illustrative examples are not measured client savings.

INTERACTIVE / ILLUSTRATIVE SCENARIO

Cash Sweep decision lab

A planning illustration of available cash, expected flows and a minimum liquidity buffer. It demonstrates a decision rule, not a trained AI model or a live payment service.

Enter USD amounts for one planning period.

Actual treasury decisions also require timing, forecast confidence, FX, legal entity, tax, intercompany and policy checks. No funds move from this tool.
